parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'project_name', p.name,
  'project_type', p.project_type,
  'location', concat_ws(', ', p.location_address, p.location_city, p.location_province),
  'property_area', p.property_area_m2
) AS proj
FROM projects p WHERE p.id = $1::uuid;
UPDATE trade_quotes SET request_email_id = $2 WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, supplier_name, status;
